theme_central: The inevitability of divine justice in the face of human arrogance — an almost continuous series of peoples destroyed for rejecting their prophet.
sources_note: Key verses confirmed by cross-checking (grokipedia / al-islam.org): Nuh 25-49, Hud 50-60, Salih 61-68. The rest (Ibrahim/Lot, Shu'ayb, Musa, closing) reconstructed from well-established landmarks, the classic pattern of repeated accounts with the formula "O my people, worship Allah, you have no other god but Him."
